scientific.integrity: The defining CGD update is specialized algebraically to an arbitrary rectangular bilinear zero-sum game. An SVD gives exact independent active singular planes and invariant Nash-nullspace components, proving both the projection-selection law and the sharp global distance rate.
limitations: The game is unconstrained, bilinear, and zero sum.
The rate is per outer iteration and does not count inner linear-solve work.
No nonlinear equilibrium-selection claim is made.

title: Competitive Gradient Descent selects the Euclidean projection onto the bilinear Nash set
